messages:
alex: heads-up — customer reported duplicate token charges when reconnecting mid-stream. looks like a prefetch snapshot replay + immediate toolcall both got provisionally billed. session id: s-77.

priya: can we see a tight trace (no PII) + which shards were involved?

alex: pasted minimal trace: ```
2026-03-21T09:42:10Z PREPREFETCH_SAVE session=s-77 shard=7 range=0-128 token=ephemeral-7a
2026-03-21T09:42:12Z CLIENT_CLOSE session=s-77
2026-03-21T09:42:15Z RESUME session=s-77 routed_shard=2 token=ephemeral-b9
2026-03-21T09:42:15Z PREFETCH_REPLAY session=s-77 range=0-128
2026-03-21T09:42:15Z TOOLCALL invoke=sql-query-14 session=s-77
2026-03-21T09:42:15Z BILL provisional session=s-77 tokens=110 source=prefetch
2026-03-21T09:42:16Z BILL provisional session=s-77 tokens=110 source=toolcall
```

sam: same pattern we've seen: placement change => different shard => resume path replays snapshot as if fresh. without a stable origin id, ledger sees two independent provisional items.

liz: short term ops idea: add a console flag that highlights "overlapping provisional ranges" for the same session id (any overlap >8 tokens). that gives CS a quick list to inspect and refund candidate sessions.

priya: medium-term: propagate an X-Origin-Session header from client through router and into provisional ledger rows. finalizer collapses overlapping ranges by origin. schema change needed for ledger row.origin and billing pipeline (batch finisher).

sam: fallback if header missing: compute a fingerprint from client-ip + user-agent + short-client-session-seed at connect time and propagate. not ideal but better than nothing.

billing-bot: alert: billing-anomaly detected acct=big-retailer at 09:43 UTC, symptom=streaming-toolcall-dup.

alex: low-risk code change we can push immediately: router checks recent provisional ledger items for this session id within a small window (3s); if a prefetch snapshot would produce a range already provisionally recorded, skip emitting the replayed prefetch event. Implement as opt-in feature flag.

liz: UI follow-up: I'll add a provisional vs finalized tokens column in session views and a "suspected duplicate" badge when overlap is detected. small mock coming.

priya: action items: alex -> router guard PR behind flag; sam -> origin-session fingerprint design doc; liz -> console telemetry column + badge; i'll coordinate billing finalizer schema + reconciliation runbook and open umbrella issue.

alex: posting draft PR in ~30m. link will be here.
sam: uploaded spec draft: https://git.redwood.local/specs/origin-session-fingerprint. includes header + fallback hashing details.
liz: mock screenshot uploaded to drive. ops can start manual triage list now.

priya: note for postmortem: consider making provisional entries "suspect" in UI until finalized to reduce accidental charge finalizations; and add a short customer-facing note if we auto-refund rare duplicate charges.

alex: thanks — will follow up with rollout plan + canary window once PR is up.
